description: Create a standalone group/tag without selecting or changing any expenses. The first call prepares a preview; after the user explicitly chooses to create it, send confirm:true with the returned operationId (fresh duplicate checks run). A first call with confirm:true still returns a preview. An exact canonical duplicate is a no-op; archived tags are not reactivated. Similar names are returned as choices; set allowSimilar:true only when the user explicitly chooses a distinct new group despite them. Use list_tags to inspect all groups.

allowSimilar.description: Allow creation alongside similar names only when the user explicitly chooses a new distinct group.

confirm.description: Confirm only after the user approves the preview; a first confirm call remains preview-only.

operationId.description: Server-issued preview operation ID to confirm a staged create.

status.description: When true, read the verified outcome for operationId without creating or changing a tag.

name: create_tag
